__prompts__.icon: Absolute path to a square PNG icon, 512px or larger (empty for a placeholder)
__prompts__.social_login_only: Sign in only through social login providers? No passwords, except a superuser's in the admin (SOCIAL_LOGIN__ONLY; changeable later)

account_deletion.__prompt__: What deleting an account does, once its grace period is over (ACCOUNTS__DELETION; changeable later)
account_deletion.erase: Erase: the account and everything of theirs goes, history included
account_deletion.anonymize: Anonymize: the account stays as a nameless tombstone, so what it did stays attributed

background_jobs.celery-with-beat: Celery worker and beat scheduler, over RabbitMQ
background_jobs.celery: Celery worker over RabbitMQ, no scheduler
background_jobs.inline: No broker or worker: a task runs in the request that asked for it, once it commits

storage.garage: Garage, bundled: self-hosted S3 in dev, tests and production
storage.s3: An S3 provider you configure for production (Garage only in dev and tests)
storage.disk: Local disk, on a Docker volume

cache.__prompt__: Cache, where rate limits keep their counts
cache.database: A table in Postgres: no service of its own, slower under load

email.__prompt__: Outgoing email (credentials go in env vars, not here)
email.smtp: Any SMTP server; printed to the log in development

phone.none: None: accounts have an email address only
phone.optional: Signup may add a number, verified by SMS; it never signs anyone in
phone.required: Signup needs a number, verified by SMS; it signs in with the password, like the address

sms.__prompt__: Outgoing SMS, used only when accounts have phone numbers (credentials go in env vars, not here)
sms.twilio: Twilio; printed to the log in development

webhooks.__prompt__: Webhooks, which POST notifications to endpoints
webhooks.none: None: notifications reach the inbox and email only
webhooks.staff: Endpoints staff register for the whole deployment
webhooks.users: Endpoints each user registers for their own notifications

name_requirement.__prompt__: What a signup asks people to be called
name_requirement.username_with_optional_full: A handle; first and last name optional
name_requirement.full_only: First and last name; no handle
name_requirement.full_and_username: First and last name, and a handle
name_requirement.full_with_optional_username: First and last name; handle optional
name_requirement.username_only: A handle; no name asked for
